**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Article IX (Product Manufacturing and Supply)** contains no purchase-exclusivity: §9.4(a) gives Ono "the right (but not the obligation)" to manufacture or engage a Subcontractor for its own requirements, backed by an Array Know-How technology transfer; §9.4(b) frames Array supply as an Ono *right* only. §2.1(b) adds a worldwide manufacturing licence extendable to third-party manufacturers. This is the preferred position — full second-sourcing freedom.
- **§8.2 (Exclusivity of Efforts)** was reviewed: it is a mutual competing-product non-compete binding Array and its Controlled Affiliates equally, with the royalty period terminating if Array competes. It restricts commercialization of competing products, not our sourcing freedom, and its reciprocity works in our favour — noted, not flagged.
- Other "exclusive" references (Article II licences, Article XII trademarks/domains) are exclusivity granted **to** Ono, which is acceptable under the rule.
